FAQ

Common Questions

Is the first game really free?

Yes, completely free. Create an account, verify your phone number, and generate one full game at no cost. No credit card needed. Same quality and features as paid games.

Is it a subscription?

No. After your free game, you pay once per game. There are no recurring charges, no monthly fees, and no hidden costs. Each additional game is a one-time purchase of $6.99.

Can I get a refund?

If generation fails or produces something fundamentally broken, yes. Contact us and we will make it right. We stand behind the quality of every generated game.

How many games can I create?

As many as you want. Each game costs $6.99 to generate. There are no limits on how many games you can create.

Do I own the game?

Yes, 100%. The generated game and all its assets are yours. You can sell it, modify it, open-source it, or do anything you want with it. No royalties, no attribution required.

What engine does it use?

All games are built with Godot 4, an open-source game engine. You get the full project files so you can open them in the Godot editor and continue development.

How long does generation take?

Typically 15-30 minutes depending on complexity. You will receive an email when your game is ready to download.

Ready to Build?

Your first game is free. Describe your idea and have a playable build in minutes.
